output.summary: An annual flowering herb that may be native to the Neotropics or central and eastern North America, redroot amaranth is now introduced across most continents. It can form a tumbleweed and bears dense flower clusters threaded with spiny green bracts.
output.edibilityNote: Leaves, stems, young shoots and seeds are eaten raw or cooked; discard boiling water because leaves contain oxalic acid and may contain nitrates.
